At Ni Hao, we believe that great food starts with great ingredients. That's why we meticulously source the freshest produce, premium meats, and aromatic spices to ensure every dish is a culinary masterpiece. item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: Oriongkp
item.content:encoded:
Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: http://orionmallgorakhpur.com.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

item.title: About
item.dc:creator: Oriongkp
item.content:encoded:
About Us

Who We Are

Amidst the immensely developing and loving city of Gorakhpur, the ultimate fashion and entertainment center is Orion Mall. Spread over an area of over 2,00,000 sq. ft. and is strategically located in Mohaddipur, a popular location near Radisson Blu. Orion Mall is inherently one of Gorakhpur’s largest and most prominent shopping malls. It is a Hub for Food, Shopping & Entertainment, comprising food courts, restaurants for premium dining, and more than 40+ national and international brands. An outstanding shopping center for people of all ages and the perfect hangout spot.

Orion Mall is a remarkable entertainment destination offering an international blend of shopping-food-entertainment, a formidable home of multiple famous brands. With over 2.5 million people per month visiting the mall and being the biggest shopping experience under one roof for locals and visitors, Orion mall takes pride to be recognized as a popular shopping destination. In the city of Gorakhpur, We are a catalyst that resembles & proceeds to add a high fashion quotient. If fashion is what you want, then the Perfect spot for you to shop is Orion Mall. You would be enshrouded in a sensory joy from the moment you walk through its doors when you are flooded with the sights, sounds, and scents of all of your favorite brands, restaurants, and entertainment places. What distinguishes us from the rest is its diverse collection of luxury multinational and national brands.

Our Location

It has never been easier to decide where and when to shop in Gorakhpur. Orion Mall delivers multiple conveniences, make the shopping experience a memorable one. It is strategically positioned on a 6-lane VIP road in a central location.
And it’s just 2km from the city center. Orion Mall is a perfect location for great entertainment, overlooking a stunning lake with groundbreaking design and state of the art architecture.

Locate Us

For little tiny-tots

Orion Mall is one of Gorakhpur’s most iconic and well-known malls, especially for the children! There are also activities other than shopping that one can do at Orion Mall, the biggest shopping spot with a gazillion brands to shop from. In the specially built gaming area, children fascinated by Legos and toys can enjoy their hearts out. You could either hang out and play or unleash the kid within you. Featuring a wide range of facilities, new open doors to entertainment and get ready to be amazed.

Explore More

Follow Us

Facebook-f Instagram Youtube

About Us

Who We Are

Amidst the immensely developing and loving city of Gorakhpur, the ultimate fashion and entertainment center is Orion Mall. Spread over an area of over 2,00,000 sq. ft. and is strategically located in Mohaddipur, a popular location near Radisson Blu. Orion Mall is inherently one of Gorakhpur’s largest and most prominent shopping malls. It is a Hub for Food, Shopping & Entertainment, comprising food courts, restaurants for premium dining, and more than 40+ national and international brands. An outstanding shopping center for people of all ages and the perfect hangout spot.

ORION MALL, GORAKHPUR

The World of happiness & fun

Orion Mall is inherently one of Gorakhpur’s largest and most prominent shopping malls. It is a Hub for Food, Shopping & Entertainment, comprising food courts, restaurants for premium dining, and more than 40+ national and international brands.

Explore Direction [ditty id=4600]

Shopping

It is a way to gain happiness

Explore

Dine

Dinner is better when we eat together

Explore

Fun Zone

Life is all about having a good time.

Explore

Book Movies

Call Us

Location

Social Media

ORION MALL EXCLUSIVE

First time in Gorakhpur . Only at Orion Mall

Amidst the immensely developing and loving city of Gorakhpur, the ultimate fashion and entertainment center is Orion Mall. Spread over an area of over 2,00,000 sq. ft. And is strategically located in Mohaddipur, a popular location near Radisson Blu. Orion Mall is inherently one of Gorakhpur’s largest and most prominent shopping malls. It is a Hub for Food, Shopping & Entertainment, comprising food courts, restaurants for premium dining, and more than 40 national and international brands. An outstanding shopping center for people of all ages and the perfect hangout spot.

Learn More

Experience
INOX Cinema

Enjoy every moment

Now Running Movies Catering your fashion needs Satisfying Your Culinary Cravings

Service Directory

Parking

Our mall features a spacious multi-level parking structure that provides ample parking space for visitors.

Escalator

Escalators are located strategically throughout the mall to provide easy access between different floors.

First Aid

These stations are equipped with basic medical supplies and staffed by trained professionals who can provide immediate assistance

Information Desk

Our friendly and knowledgeable staff are here to assist you and ensure you have a pleasant shopping experience.

Learn More [trustindex no-registration=google]

item.title: Cafe
item.dc:creator: Oriongkp
item.content:encoded:
Cafe

Fourth Floor

Facebook Twitter Youtube  5/5

Quick Service Restaurant| Cuisines | Shakes | Beverages | Food Court

The London shakes are the re-inventors of one of the most popular drink in the world the Milk Shakes. It is believed that the combination of Milk, Rich cream, and fruit syrup or extract originated in London and now is popular all over the world. Milk has been the most popular drink in India, a rich history is linked with the milk & its products. We at ‘The London Shakes’ want to spread the legacy of milk in a better way yet maintaining its rich values. Drinking milk is now so much fun with the addition of flavours & Love. Come and Enjoy "The London Mil Shakes" here We welcome you all here.

  • Serves:   Drinks and Shakes
  • Address: Fourth Floor
  • Call on: +91-9839634311
  • Email:  arunit35@gmail.com
  • MONDAY – SUNDAY: 11:00 AM TO 11:00 PM

Fourth Floor

Facebook Twitter Youtube  5/5

Quick Service Restaurant | Cuisines | Tea | Coffee | Food Court

Devil Drinks’ a delicious drinks & Fast-food restaurant and definitely the talk of the town, a true destination for every family’s taste bite, best taste and the food you always crave for. Tsunami of taste and abundance of flavours, stretched options from all mood ‘KADAK CHAI ‘ to chilled lassi’s ,COFFEE looking for a good coffee to talk over or in mood of fresh fruit juices, wide variety of beverages available here, everything under a single roof because we just don’t brag it, we do actually serve it. Regrets about taste aren’t entertained here because we really do value your taste and choice.

  • Address:  Fourth Floor
  • Call on: +91-9839243533
  • Email: devildrinkgkp@gmail.com
  • MONDAY – SUNDAY: 11:00 AM TO 11:00 PM

Restaurant

Ground Floor

Facebook Twitter Youtube  5/5

Restaurant| Cuisines | Fast food | Quick bites

KFC is an American fast food restaurant chain. KFC’s signature dishes include the “crispy outside, juicy inside” hot and crispy chicken, flavorful and juicy original recipe chicken, the spicy, juicy & crunchy zinger burger, toasted twister, chicken bucket and a host of beverages and desserts. For the vegetarians in India, KFC also has great tasting vegetarian offerings that include the veg zinger and veggie snacker. Check out their finger licking good menu now! We always welcome you at "KFC". Come and Visit us.

item.content:encoded:
Food Court

Third Floor

 Rated 5 out of 5

Quick Service Restaurant | Cuisines | Pizza | Food Court

Domino’s Pizza, Inc., branded as Domino’s, is an American multinational pizza restaurant chain founded in 1961. The corporation is Delaware domiciled and headquartered at the Domino’s Farms Office Park in Ann Arbor, Michigan. We take pride in using only the freshest and highest quality ingredients for our pizzas. From our signature hand-tossed dough to our flavorful sauces and premium toppings, every bite is a burst of pure satisfaction. Customize your order with a wide range of toppings, sauces, and crust options. We always welcome you at "Domino's Pizza". Come and Visit us. 

  • Menu: Meat Ball | Deluxe Veggie | Taco-Mexicana-Veg | Mexicana green wave
  • Address: THIRD FLOOR
  • Call on: +91-7523966287
  •  Email To: dp63848@gmail.com
    MONDAY – SUNDAY: 11:00 AM TO 11:00 PM

Third Floor

Facebook Twitter Youtube  Rated 5 out of 5

Restaurant| Dine

"Bikaner's Kitchen" is likely a reference to a culinary establishment or restaurant located in Bikaner, a city in the state of Rajasthan, India. Bikaner is known for its rich culinary heritage, especially for its delectable sweets and snacks.. We always welcome you at "Bikaner's Kitchen". Come and Visit us. 

  • Menu: Ice cream, Coffee, Italian snacks and food.
  • Address: Third Floor
  • Call on: 9519683838
  • Email : uniquefoods@gmail.com
  • MONDAY – SUNDAY: 11:00 AM TO 11:00 PM

Third Floor

 Rated 5 out of 5

Quick Service Restaurant | Cuisines | Chinese | Food Court

A number of different styles contribute to Chinese cuisine but perhaps the best known and most influential are Cantonese cuisine, Shandong cuisine, Jiangsu cuisine (specifically Huaiyang cuisine) and Sichuan cuisine. … Anhui cuisine incorporates wild food for an unusual taste and is wilder than Fujian cuisine. At Ni Hao, we believe that great food starts with great ingredients. That's why we meticulously source the freshest produce, premium meats, and aromatic spices to ensure every dish is a culinary masterpiece. You can taste the difference in every bite. We always welcome you at "Ni Hao". Come and Visit us. 

  • Menu: Roasted Lumb Chops | Chinese Dumplings | Chicken Samosa | Chicken Caesar Salad
  • Address: THIRD FLOOR
  • Call on: +91-9519683838
  • Email To: uniquefoods@gmail.com
  • MONDAY – SUNDAY: 11:00 AM TO 11:00 PM

Third Floor

 Rated 5 out of 5

Quick Service Restaurant | Cuisines | Fast food | Food Court

Burger King (BK) is an American multinational chain of hamburger fast food restaurants. It has expanded from a basic offering of burgers, french fries, sodas, and milkshakes to a larger and more diverse set of products. You can taste the difference in every bite. We believe that great taste starts with quality ingredients. That's why we source the freshest produce, the juiciest beef, and the finest ingredients for our burgers. Every bite is a burst of flavor you won't forget. We always welcome you at "Burger King". Come and Visit us. 

  • Menu: BK Veggie Burger Combo | Veg Chilli Cheese Melt Burger | Crispy Veg Supreme Burger | Veg Chilli Cheese Melt Burger Combo
  • Address: SHOP NO T1 | THIRD FLOOR
  • Call on: +91-8750213637/ 9321909881
  • Email To: oriongkpr@burgerking.in
  • MONDAY – SUNDAY: 11:00 AM TO 11:00 PM

Third Floor

 Rated 5 out of 5

Quick Service Restaurant | Cuisines | Streat Food | Food Court

Chaat Ka Chaska is one of India’s leading and successful food business franchisers, is offering street food and Chaat franchise business opportunities in India. If you are one of those minds who are keen on doing food business and get success in the business, then Chaat Ka Chaska, a chaat franchise business model, is just the right option for you. No one can just resist the flavours of fresh and local street foods. Well, street foods are must for the backpackers to eat outside on a budget however; they are unhygienic and not so healthy. Thus, people prefer restaurants for eating chaat or any other kind of street foods. And this is the reason why investors are investing in a chaat franchise business. 

  • Menu: Jalebi With Rabadi | Bhel | Raj Kachori | Panipuri
  • Address: THIRD FLOOR
  • Call on: +91-9839634311
  • Email To: arunit35@gmail.com
  • MONDAY – SUNDAY: 11:00 AM TO 11:00 PM

Third Floor

 Rated 5 out of 5

Fast food । Quick bites

The restaurant, formerly known as Pete’s Super Submarines, was renamed Subway and is now a global franchise. It is located in over 37,500 places and spread over 100 countries and territories. At Orion Mall, the shopping mall in Gorakhpur, Subway serves you the best submarine sandwiches, wraps, salads, and beverages, along with baked foods such as cookies, doughnuts, and muffins. It is known for its quality and a rich option for topping sandwiches. We use fresh ingredients to prepare our food items in order to carry forward the longtime Subway slogan, ‘Eat Fresh’.

  • Menu: Fast food । Quick bites
  • Address: SHOP NO 7B | THIRD FLOOR
  • Call on: +91 7307437059
  • Email To: subgkp@gmail.com
  • MONDAY – SUNDAY: 11:00 AM TO 11:00 PM

Third Floor

Crimson Cafe

 Rated 5 out of 5

Casual Dining

Nestled in the heart of the city, Crimson Cafe is more than just a place to grab a coffee—it's a vibrant gathering spot where art, culture, and culinary delights meet. Whether you're seeking a cozy nook to escape with a book, a lively atmosphere to catch up with friends, or a creative space to spark inspiration, Crimson Cafe has something for everyone. 

  • Menu: Burger | Pizza | Pasta | Fried Chicken | More
  • Address: Third Floor
  • Call on: 7042493937
  • Email: ChandanRay169@gmail.com
  • MONDAY – SUNDAY: 11:00 AM TO 11:00 PM

Wow momo Wow china Wow Kulfi

 Rated 5 out of 5

Located inside the vibrant Orion Mall, Gorakhpur, the new Wow Food Zone brings together three exciting brands under one roof — Wow! Momo, Wow! China, and Wow! Kulfi.

From juicy steamed & fried momos to bold Indo-Chinese flavours and refreshing traditional kulfis, this outlet offers a complete quick-bite experience for every craving. Perfect for shoppers, families, and food lovers looking to enjoy street-style favourites with a modern twist — all at one convenient spot in the mall’s food court.

  • Menu: Momo | Chinese | Kulfi
  • Address: Third Floor
  • Call on: - 8009932615

Footwears

Ground Floor

Facebook Twitter Youtube  Rated 5 out of 5

Quick Shop: shoes,sandals, boots,flip flops,flats,sneakers for men,women & kids.

Experience the unparalleled comfort that only Crocs can offer. Our signature Croslite™ material provides cushioning and support, making every step a delight. Say goodbye to tired feet and hello to all-day comfort. Crocs is not just about comfort; it's about making a style statement too. Explore our wide range of footwear. Express your unique personality with a wide array of vibrant colors and trendy patterns. Crocs let you showcase your individuality while staying comfortable and stylish. From classic clogs and sandals to stylish sneakers and flats, there's a pair of Crocs for everyone. We always welcome you at "Crocs". Come and Visit us. 

  • Shop: clogs, shoes,sandals, boots,flip flops,flats,sneakers for men,women & kids.
  • Address: Shop no-G9 Ground Floor Orion Mall Mohaddipur Gorakhpur
  • Call on: 9324273531
  • Email At: gkp@crocsindian.com
  • MONDAY – SUNDAY: 11:00 AM TO 11:00 PM

First Floor

Facebook Twitter Youtube  Rated 5 out of 5

Quick Shop: Sports & Fitness | Foot Fashion

Skechers is a billion-dollar-plus global leader in the high performance and lifestyle footwear industry, Skechers USA, Inc. designs, develops and markets more than 3,000 styles for men, women, and children. Experience unparalleled comfort with Skechers' revolutionary footwear technology. Our shoes are designed with advanced cushioning, responsive soles, and breathable materials, ensuring all-day comfort for your feet. Stay on top of the latest fashion of your big city. Express yourself with footwear that turns heads wherever you go. Say goodbye to tired feet and hello to walking on clouds! We always welcome you at "Skechers". Come and Visit us. 

  • Shop: Men's Footwear
  • Address: 1st floor, Orion Mal
  • Call on: +91 8108339897,  7523985006
  • Email At: skechers.oriongkp@gmail.com
  • MONDAY – SUNDAY: 11:00 AM TO 11:00 PM

1st Floor

Facebook Twitter Youtube  Rated 5 out of 5

Quick Shop: Sports & Fitness | Foot Fashion

Reebok International Limited is an American fitness footwear and clothing brand that is a part of Authentic Brands Group. It was established in England in 1958 as a companion company to J.W. Foster and Sons, a sporting goods company which had been founded in 1895 in Bolton, Lancashire. From 1958 until 1986, the brand featured the flag of the United Kingdom in its logo to signify the origins of the company. It was bought by German sporting goods company Adidas in 2005, then sold to the United States-based Authentic Brands Group in 2021. The company's global headquarters are located in Boston, Massachusetts, in the Seaport District. We always welcome you at "Reebok". Come and Visit us. 

  • Shop: Footwear
  • Address: Shop no. F-3 , First floor
  • Call on: 7518069087
  • Email: sr.320356@abfrl.adityabirla.com
  • MONDAY – SUNDAY: 11:00 AM TO 11:00 PM

Cosmetic / Unisex Salon

Ground Floor

Facebook Twitter Youtube  5/5

Quick Shop: Cosmetics and Beauty products

Orion Mall, the best shopping mall in Gorakhpur, in-houses the new cosmetic brand on its ground floor. You can find your favourite collection of make-up items for lips, eyes, and face, skincare products, such as moisturizers, sunscreen, masks, etc., and brushes. The brand is supported by the conviction of renowned investors and the fervour of millions of fans of beauty. Sugar Cosmetics, one of the fastest-growing companies, the latest in the list is a store at Orion Mall, Visit us and be in line with the latest cosmetic and make-up trends. We always welcome you at "Sugar". Come and Visit us.

Facebook Twitter Youtube  5/5

Quick Shop: Unisex Salon | Beauty Salon

Revlon, Inc. is an American multinational company dealing in cosmetics, skin care, fragrance, and personal care. The headquarters of Revlon was established in New York City on March 1, 1932, where it still remains. Revlon was founded by brothers Charles and Joseph Revlon, and chemist Charles Lachman. Revlon products are sold in 150 countries and the company has many global locations including Mexico City, London, Paris, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Sydney, Singapore, and Tokyo.

  • Shop: For men and women

Quick Shop: Perfume brand | Bath and Body products | Skincare

Bella Vita is a fragrance and skincare brand that was founded in 2018 by Anju Anand and Aashima Anand. Bella Vita products are made with perfume oils from France, Spain, and Italy, and are bottled in India. Bella Vita's products include:
  • PerfumesBella Vita's perfumes are luxurious and long-lasting, and are made with perfume oils from France, Spain, and Italy.
  • Bath and body productsBella Vita's best-selling perfumes are infused in their bath and body range.
  • Skincare products

    Bella Vita's skincare products are organic, cruelty-free, and chemical-free.

  • Shop: For men and women

Facebook Twitter Youtube  5/5

Quick Shop: handbags and accessories

Caprese is a premier lifestyle brand that embodies the essence of modern sophistication with a touch of effortless elegance. Inspired by the vibrant spirit and picturesque landscapes of the Italian island of Capri, Caprese brings to life a collection of handbags and accessories that are as stylish as they are functional.Founded with a vision to create high-quality fashion accessories that cater to the contemporary woman, Caprese offers a wide range of products, from chic handbags and wallets to trendy backpacks and slings. Each piece is thoughtfully designed to blend classic aesthetics with modern trends, ensuring that every item not only makes a statement but also complements the fast-paced lifestyle of today's women.
  • Shop: For Women

Gadgets / Accessories / Gifts & More

Ground Floor

Facebook Twitter Youtube  Rated 5 out of 5

Quick Shop: Mobile and Laptop

At Orion Mall, the mall in Gorakhpur, you can buy your favourite electronic devices from Samsung, the largest manufacturer of mobile phones and smartphones. The well-known Samsung Galaxy line of devices is now easily available here. The company has developed 5G capable smartphones. In addition, we also offer Android-powered Samsung Galaxy Tab collection along with the Galaxy Book2 Pro series of laptop for everyone. At Orion Mall, the largest shopping mall in Gorakhpur. Come and buy your favourite Samsung mobiles and laptops from Orion Mall. We always welcome you at "Samsung". Come and Visit us.

  • Call on: +91-9616611111

Ground Floor

Facebook Twitter Youtube  Rated 5 out of 5

Quick Shop: Phone | Apple | Accessories

iDelta is an Indian Premium and Authorized Reseller of Apple Products in India.

Having high aspirations, the foundation of iDelta was placed to set up a new milestone in customer service and store operations. With incessant efforts we've spread our horizon across states of Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Punjab and Haryana having seven stores and four service centers in Meerut, Lucknow, Dehradun, Faridabad, Ludhiana , Jalandhar and now in Gorakhpur at Orion Mall.

Our aim is to share our enthusiasm and passion for all things Apple ensuring you have the very best experience every time you visit one of our stores.

Our showrooms are designed with Apple's world-class standards, where we showcase and demo the latest Apple products in India.

  • Shop: Apple Products

  • Call on: 9917048884
  • Email At: gorakhpur@idelta.co.in

Bags

Established in 1968, VIP Industries Limited is amongst World’s leading manufacturers and retailers of luggage, backpacks and handbags and an established leader in the organised luggage market in India. In addition to our strong presence in India, We have a growing global footprint with our products supplied in over 45 countries. Our operations are underpinned by our market-leading brand portfolio, in-house manufacturing capabilities and wide distribution network. Since our inception, we have stayed focussed on continuous product innovations and adherence to quality and international aesthetics, enabling us to revolutionise the luggage and travel categories.

Titan Company Ltd is the world’s fifth largest wrist watch manufacturer and India’s leading producer of watches. The company is engaged in manufacturing of watches, jewelry, precision engineering and Eyewear. They produce watches under the brand name Titan, Fastrack, Sonata, Nebula, RAGA, Regalia, Octane & Xylys. Titan has been synonymous with impeccable craftsmanship for decades. Each timepiece and jewelry piece is meticulously crafted, combining precision engineering with artistic design. Experience the highest standards of quality and attention to detail that define Titan. We always welcome you at "Titan". Come and Visit us.

.. Come and Visit us.

Gifting| Clothing | Bedding | Pre School | Baby Gear | Baby Furniture | Diaper Bags |

Babies are gentle. They are the bearers of all things fresh and joyful in our lives. Babies are heartwarming. They charm their way into the moments we cherish for a lifetime. They are our sunshine and rainbow.

At Mi Arcus, we understand that the happiness and comfort of your little one is your priority. Therefore, we present to you a wide range of Premium Baby & Mom products to support your goal of providing the utmost care at all stages of your pregnancy & baby’s growth.

Keeping the baby’s well being in our mind, Mi Arcus encourages pioneering expertise in baby care product development and ensures working ardently towards creating a legacy. We have focused diligently on creating products with BCI-Cotton to ensure safety for babies and mothers. This eliminates the presence of any harmful dyes or chemicals whatsoever. Furthermore, our continued steps to encourage eco-friendly packaging intends to help our planet, one product at a time to promote sustainability. Delivering gentle, quality-approved, and eco-friendly products for mothers and babies is a sincere promise: From us to you.

The organization has been associated with prestigious International brands for the supply of textiles since over two decades and have been able to provide employment to a million people throughout the system. Mi Arcus, born with the inheritance of decades of experience of creating quality products which aim at providing love, comfort & warmth to your baby.

item.title: Yoga Day'2023
item.dc:creator: Oriongkp
item.content:encoded:
International Yoga Day, also known as World Yoga Day, is celebrated annually on June 21st. It was officially declared by the United Nations General Assembly in 2014, following a proposal by Prime Minister of India, Narendra Modi. The declaration aimed to raise awareness about the benefits of yoga for individuals and communities worldwide.
The significance of International Yoga Day lies in promoting holistic well-being, physical fitness, and mental harmony. It is an occasion to highlight the transformative power of yoga and its potential to foster unity, peace, and sustainable development.

item.content:encoded:
Fun Zone

Third Floor

Facebook Twitter Youtube  Rated 5 out of 5

Quick Shop: Play Zone

Step into our store and be amazed by our vast collection of toys and games for all ages. From classic board games to the latest action figures, we have everything you need to unleash your imagination and create unforgettable memories. Planning a birthday bash or special event? Look no further! Fun Unlimited offers a wide range of party supplies, decorations, and themed accessories to make your celebration truly unforgettable. we have something for every occasion and every person. Let us help you create a magical atmosphere that will leave everyone smiling from ear to ear. We always welcome you at "Fun Unlimited". Come and Visit us.

  • Shop: Play Zone
  • Address: Third floor
  • Call on: 8948451814
  • Email: fununlimitedgkp@gmail.com
  • MONDAY – SUNDAY: 11:00 AM TO 11:00 PM

2nd Floor

Facebook Twitter Youtube  Rated 5 out of 5

Quick Shop: Game zone

Step into a world of excitement and fun at Game Zone, the premier bowling alley in Gorakhpur. Whether you're a seasoned bowler or just looking for a great time with friends and family, our state-of-the-art facility offers the perfect setting for unforgettable moments.

  • Shop: Game zone
  • Address: 2nd Floor
  • Call on: 9569758019
  • Email: fununlimitedgop@gmail.com
  • MONDAY – SUNDAY: 11:00 AM TO 11:00 PM

item.content:encoded:
Chocolates / Ice Cream / Juice

Ground Floor

Facebook Twitter Youtube  Rated 5 out of 5

Ice Cream

The mouth-watering ice cream, which originated 400 years ago in Turkey and is made from Salep, milk, sugar, and added flavours, is now enjoyed by the whole world, including India. Thanks to our Turquoise Ice Cream master and showman Sahin Ozturk, who continues the tradition of his forefathers and strives to take the ice cream venture to the next level. Turquoise is the first Turkish company that introduced the hand-made Turkish Ice Cream in India. It is spreading its ice cream business all over India by partnering with Indian people and giving them Franchises. Orion Mall, the best mall in Gorakhpur, is one of the first in the city to open a branch of this popular Turkish Ice Cream.

  • Call on: 8808839576

item.title: World Environment Day
item.dc:creator: Oriongkp
item.content:encoded: World Environment Day is a campaign observed world wide every year on 5th June to raise awareness about environment protection of nature and the planet Earth. Keeping this aim in view Orion Mall initiated the awareness event about Environment conservation and inspired people to save nature and preserve our precious resources along with plant distribution at Orion Mall

item.dc:creator: Oriongkp
item.content:encoded:
74th Republic Day Celebration with pride at Orion Mall Gorakhpur.
Today, we put our hand on our heart, look up to the sky, and salute the heroes who helped build this glorious Nation.
Orion Mall wishes one and all a very happy republic day.

item.title: International Yoga Day
item.dc:creator: Oriongkp
item.content:encoded:
A Happy soul, a fresh mind, a healthy body.
All three can be achieved with yoga
On the occasion of 8th International Yoga Day, under the joint aegis of NCC and SSB, efforts were made to make the citizens aware of yoga and health through yoga practice in the famous Orion Mall of the city. Simultaneously, the SSB jawans encouraged the morale of the people doing a live band in Orion Mall, this program was done in the presence of SSB's D.I.G Shri Rajnish Lamba!
On this occasion, Group Commander of NCC, Brigadier Deependra Rawat, Colonel Rajesh Chandrel, Orion Mall Director Suneet Tekriwal & Director Amit Tekriwal together made people aware of yoga and health through yoga exercises.

item.title: Shop & Win Lucky Draw Celebration – 6th Anniversary Special
item.dc:creator: Oriongkp
item.content:encoded:
Orion Mall Gorakhpur proudly celebrated its 6th Anniversary with a grand Shop & Win Lucky Draw Event, marking a memorable milestone filled with excitement, rewards, and celebrations.

Event Highlights

  • The lucky draw was announced by Bollywood celebrity Rakesh Bedi, adding prominence to the occasion.

  • The event witnessed enthusiastic participation from shoppers across the city.

  • Winners were selected through a transparent process in the presence of mall management and guests.

Lucky Draw Winners

The celebration rewarded lucky shoppers with exciting prizes:

  • 1st Prize: Car – Shailendra Soni

  • 2nd Prize: Bike – Aman Singh

  • 3rd Prize: Malaysia Trip – Madhuri Singh

  • 4th Prize: Thailand Trip – Vikash Kumar

  • 5th Prize: Samsung A11 Plus Tab – Anjali Singh

  • 6th Prize: Samsung A17 (6/128) – Shabbir

Festive Sale and Celebrations

The event coincided with Republic Day celebrations, featuring The Big Republic Sale with discounts up to 50% OFF across multiple retail brands, creating an engaging shopping experience for visitors.

A Celebration of Trust and Joy

This anniversary event reflects Orion Mall Gorakhpur’s commitment to delivering exceptional shopping experiences, premium brands, and customer-focused celebrations. With an extensive range of retail outlets, dining options, and entertainment, the mall continues to stand as the city’s preferred shopping and lifestyle destination.

Thank you to all our shoppers for making this celebration a grand success.

item.title: Republic Day Celebration at Orion Mall Gorakhpur
item.dc:creator: Oriongkp
item.content:encoded:
Orion Mall Gorakhpur celebrated Republic Day with great enthusiasm and patriotic spirit, creating a vibrant and festive atmosphere for shoppers and visitors.

Event Overview

The mall was beautifully themed in the colors of the national flag, reflecting pride, unity, and the true essence of Republic Day. Visitors enjoyed a lively environment filled with celebration, togetherness, and memorable moments.

Highlights of the Celebration

  • Patriotic décor across the mall premises

  • High footfall with families and shoppers participating in the celebration

  • Special shopping experiences and festive ambiance throughout the day

  • A perfect blend of celebration, shopping, and entertainment

Special Republic Day Offers

As part of the celebration, Orion Mall hosted The Big Republic Sale, offering discounts of up to 50% OFF across a wide range of brands, making it an ideal destination for festive shopping.

Celebrating the Spirit of India

The Republic Day celebration at Orion Mall Gorakhpur reaffirmed its commitment to bringing the community together through meaningful events, premium shopping experiences, and a welcoming environment for all age groups.

Orion Mall continues to be a preferred destination where celebrations, culture, and lifestyle come together under one roof.

item.title: Mother’s Day Health & Wellness Camp at Orion Mall
item.dc:creator: Oriongkp
item.content:encoded:
Orion Mall proudly celebrated Mother’s Day with a meaningful community initiative featuring a Free Eye Check-Up Camp and CPR Training Camp in association with Fatima Hospital.

The event witnessed enthusiastic participation from families, shoppers, healthcare professionals, and visitors who came together to promote health awareness and emergency preparedness. Guests benefited from complimentary eye screenings, expert medical guidance, and live CPR training sessions conducted by trained healthcare staff.

Along with celebrating the spirit of motherhood, the event aimed to encourage preventive healthcare and educate people about life-saving emergency response techniques. The atmosphere at Orion Mall was filled with care, learning, and community engagement, making the celebration both memorable and impactful.

Stay connected with Orion Mall for more exciting events, community activities, and celebrations.
